title: Mentors, accountants, attorneys and free help

sources.claim: SCORE is an SBA resource partner offering free volunteer mentoring (some workshops charge fees); Small Business Development Centers (SBDCs) offer free or low-cost consulting through host institutions.

sections.skill: Match questions to mentors, free programs and licensed professionals

questions.prompt: What does SCORE offer?

choices.text: Free business loans for every owner
Free tax filing for all businesses

questions.intro: Help comes in different forms. MENTORS share experience and can spot blind spots. SCORE, an SBA resource partner, offers free volunteer mentoring (some workshops charge fees). SMALL BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT CENTERS (SBDCs) offer free or low-cost consulting through host institutions. Libraries and local chambers of commerce may run workshops. For specific legal or tax decisions, a licensed ATTORNEY or ACCOUNTANT gives advice for your situation. Free help is valuable, but check the person's experience and whether they are qualified for your question.
